resources.string: The objective of the game is to identify \'sets\' of 3 cards. Each card is unique in its 3 features: color, shape, and shading. A \'set\' consists of 3 cards on which each feature is either the same on all 3 cards, or different on all 3 cards.
The player gets 10 points for each feature that\'s all the same and 20 points for each feature that\'s all different. The score for each \'set\' is the sum of points for all 3 features.
